$comment: What the AI must never do. Only what is listed here is blocked. Give every rule a reason. Commands you type yourself with ! are not blocked. Put personal rules in rules.local.json (gitignored).

commands.name: sudo
commands.reason: Never let the AI run commands with administrator rights

commands.name: rm -rf
commands.reason: Recursive force deletes skip the trash and cannot be undone

commands.name: .env
commands.reason: .env files hold keys, so the AI must not read them

commands.name: git push --force
commands.reason: Rewriting remote history cannot be undone from anywhere else

commands.name: git reset --hard
commands.reason: Uncommitted changes are lost for good

commands.name: git clean -f
commands.reason: Untracked files are deleted without going through the trash

commands.name: git checkout .
commands.reason: All uncommitted changes are thrown away at once

paths.name: .env
paths.reason: .env files hold keys, so the AI must not read them

paths.name: .env.*
paths.reason: .env files hold keys, so the AI must not read them
